decision_notes: National legislature/chamber identity cross-checked against the institution, Wikidata and the primary IPU profile where accessible. This is separate from media and rights evidence. Primary evidence: https://data.ipu.org/parliament/JM/

The Parliament homepage explicitly designates PBCJ and its YouTube channel. Public Accounts and Domestic Violence Committee recordings show actual proceedings at 30 minutes. Both a provider-live Senate title and a separately archived Senate-labelled video show public-service programming at the sampled positions; Senate chamber activity is not validated by those titles.

Source conditions: Houses of Parliament allows attributed noncommercial reproduction of its own site material with accuracy and no endorsement conditions; commercial reuse needs consent. This is not a blanket grant for PBCJ or third-party audiovisual material. Use the official programme index and keep independent playback disabled.
Catalogue, flags, localized country/jurisdiction search, map and planned schedule-source links reconciled. Link-out only; no HLS or implemented EPG promotion.
